product_one_liner.value: Bizagi is a low-code automation and orchestration platform for enterprises to automate business processes and build enterprise apps by connecting people, systems, data, AI and bots.
product_one_liner.notes: Based on Bizagi's company description and homepage.

pricing_page.notes: Bizagi has a public page describing its consumption-based pricing, even though it directs visitors to request a quote or brochure.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear as customer case studies on Bizagi's customer page.

employee_band.notes: Bizagi's LinkedIn company profile reports 201-500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Bizagi identifies Washington DC as its headquarters; its company profile identifies the United States.

founded_year.notes: Bizagi's about page says it was founded in 1989.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product, industry and business-oriented thought-leadership/news content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Bizagi provides a public help center with multiple product documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers listing includes an AI-First Full Stack Developer opening.

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure OpenAI (Azure Private OpenAI GPT service)
model_provider.notes: Bizagi's AI documentation says its AI capabilities use models through Microsoft Azure services and identifies Azure's Private OpenAI GPT service.

compliance_certs.notes: The compliance page names ISO 27001, HIPAA and GDPR; it does not state that SOC 2 or PCI DSS is a Bizagi certification.

last_funding.notes: The announcement reports the $48 million minority investment, and the funding profile identifies it as the latest round on September 13, 2017.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round identified in the funding history was September 13, 2017, before the period beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Bizagi's career site lists a Business Development Representative (BDR) posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Bizagi announced its Summer 2026 platform release on July 21, 2026, including major feature additions such as Kafka event streaming.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile identifies Samir Gulati as Chief Marketing Officer at Bizagi and shows his Bizagi role ending in April 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Bizagi's connector documentation names HubSpot and Salesforce connectors.
